messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert: multiple inference-prod-us-west-2 nodes reporting progressive GPU OOMs / container crashes. Error spike at 12:17 UTC. Auto-mitigation started: evict-heavy-jobs, sticky-fallbacks engaged. Please triage.

maya: oncall here — ack. seeing increased 5xx on /v1/generate, latency spikes on long-context jobs.

chen: logs show repeated `CUDA kernel launch failed: out of memory` followed by container restart on node gpu-14. Also paged-attn eviction chatter.

oliver: customer-facing impact? any client throttles?

maya: a few high-traffic tenants (embedding pipelines) hit errors for requests >6k tokens. Roughly 1.8% of total requests, but concentrated. CS notified for impacted teams.

chen: reproducing locally with long sequence replay — memory climbs steadily, fragmentation counters on the KV allocator increase. suspect slow KV-heap silt accumulation (paged fragments not freed).

maya: immediate plan: 1) disable long-context routing todedicated pool 2) increase KV slab compaction aggressiveness 3) roll nodes to clear resident fragments. doing 1 now.

oliver: how to toggle routing?

maya: ops-bot: run `/infra toggle-route --route long-context --state off` — ops-bot confirmed toggle. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: route long-context disabled across prod region us-west-2.

chen: starting compaction bump: set `kv.compact_interval_ms=30000` and `kv.compact_threshold=0.4` on affected nodes. pushing change to runtime config.

oliver: is there risk of latency regression from more aggressive compaction?

chen: small risk for happy-paths but acceptable given current OOM frequency. we'll monitor p50/p99.

maya: starting rolling restart of the 3 worst nodes (gpu-12/13/14). draining to 0 connections before reboot.

sre_lead: capture heap + nvprof traces before reboot if possible. set `collect-kv-snapshot=true` in the node agent.

chen: grabbing heap dump now. snapshot saved to s3://redwood-internal/kv-snapshots/6612345678-gpu14.tar.gz. nvprof shows repeated CUDA `cuMemAlloc` failures interleaved with fragmentation warnings.

maya: customers still seeing errors? rate down to ~3% errors after routing toggle + compaction bump. nodes still report growing resident set between compactions.

oliver: any config change we rolled in last 24h that could correlate?

chen: we pushed small allocator tweak yesterday (`paged-slot-reserve=0.03`) to reduce reserved pages for small models — might have increased fragmentation under tail workloads. filing revert candidate.

maya: quick rollback proposed: revert `paged-slot-reserve` to previous 0.1 on a canary node, observe.

ops-bot: initiating canary config revert on gpu-12.

ops-bot: canary revert applied.

chen: monitoring canary: after revert, fragmentation metrics on canary flattening, no OOMs in 12m sample. good sign.

maya: next steps: 1) roll revert across affected pool 2) maintain higher compaction interval for next 6 hours 3) keep long-context route disabled 4) ask infra to provision 2 spare gpus as buffer if farm continues to degrade.

oliver: customer update for CS: "We're seeing a subset of long-context requests fail intermittently due to memory fragmentation; we've applied a rollback to an allocator tuning and increased compaction, which has reduced errors. We're continuing to stabilize and will update in 1 hour." good?

sre_lead: yes. also include that we captured heap/nvprof and will follow up with a patch to make small-page reservations adaptive.

chen: opening incident ticket INC-661234 — root cause suspected: allocator reservation change causing paged-attn fragmentation resulting in slow memory creep and eventual CUDA OOM on sustained long-context loads. attaching logs/snapshots.

maya: monitoring dashboards: p99 latency and OOM count trending down. leaving routing off for now. if stable for 30m we can start limited reenable to canary tenants.

ops-bot: nodes gpu-12/13/14 rolled and back in healthy state. no new crashes in last 18m.

oliver: thanks team. after stabilization, let's schedule a postmortem and action items: adaptive reservation, better KPIs for fragmentation, and an oncall runbook step for rapid revert.

maya: noted. I'll draft the PM and link snapshots. closing active mitigation loop unless anyone sees fresh alerts.

chen: leaving a watch on nvml OOM events and compaction metrics for 2 hours. ping me if anything spikes.

incident-bot: SEV2 -> status: mitigated (partial). updates will be appended to INC-661234.
